rates.label: On-time resolution
rates.description: Share of decisions reached inside the 45- or 90-day deadline.

rates.label: Provisional-credit timeliness
rates.description: Share of required temporary credits issued by business day 10.

rates.label: Provisional-credit rate
rates.description: Share of claims that received a temporary credit; lower means more claims resolved inside 10 business days.

rates.label: Provisional-credit reversal rate
rates.description: Share of finalized temporary credits that were taken back.

rates.label: Customer win rate
rates.description: Share of decisions that went the customer's way; a rise can signal fraud or merchant problems.

rates.label: Chargeback win rate
rates.description: Share of decided chargebacks the bank won.

rates.label: Withdrawal rate
rates.description: Share of claims the customer withdrew.

rates.label: Recovery rate
rates.description: Share of money credited to customers that came back through chargebacks.

rates.label: Loss rate
rates.description: Share of customer wins where the bank absorbed at least part of the credit.

rates.label: Write-off rate
rates.description: Share of disputed dollars the bank absorbed as a loss.

dictionary.plain_english: Demo data for Northwind Bank, generated for this portfolio project with a fixed seed.

dictionary.methodology: Last 12 full months plus the current partial month: 2025-11-01 to 2026-11-23

dictionary.methodology: Claims are assigned to the period (month, or week starting Monday) they were received

dictionary.methodology: 12 CFR 1005.11: credit if not resolved within 10 business days of notice (weekends skipped; holidays ignored)
dictionary.plain_english: If a claim takes longer than 10 business days, the customer gets their money back temporarily.

dictionary.methodology: 45 days standard; 90 days for new accounts (opened <= 30 days) and foreign / point-of-sale transactions
dictionary.plain_english: The deadline for reaching a decision.

dictionary.methodology: Within 3 business days of resolution
dictionary.plain_english: Customers are told the outcome within 3 business days.

dictionary.methodology: Generic network rule: filed within 120 days of the transaction
dictionary.plain_english: How long the bank has to dispute a charge with the merchant's bank.

dictionary.methodology: A cohort month is mature when its Total resolved_rate >= 98%; a week is mature when every month it touches is mature; months older than the maturation table are mature

dictionary.methodology: Fixed per rate (see each rate below); met = at or above a higher-is-better target, at or below a lower-is-better target

dictionary.methodology: claim_transactions / card_transactions; monthly target <= 45 per 10,000

dictionary.methodology: resolved_within_deadline / resolved_claims; monthly target >= 98.0%
dictionary.plain_english: Share of decisions reached inside the 45- or 90-day deadline. Higher is better. Target: at least 98.0%.

dictionary.methodology: pc_within_10bd / pc_due; monthly target >= 97.5%
dictionary.plain_english: Share of required temporary credits issued by business day 10. Higher is better. Target: at least 97.5%.

dictionary.methodology: pc_issued / claims; monthly target <= 49.0%
dictionary.plain_english: Share of claims that received a temporary credit; lower means more claims resolved inside 10 business days. Lower is better. Target: at most 49.0%.

dictionary.methodology: pc_reversed / pc_finalized; monthly target <= 28.0%
dictionary.plain_english: Share of finalized temporary credits that were taken back. Lower is better. Target: at most 28.0%.

dictionary.methodology: customer_wins / resolved_claims; monthly target <= 73.5%
dictionary.plain_english: Share of decisions that went the customer's way; a rise can signal fraud or merchant problems. Lower is better. Target: at most 73.5%.

dictionary.methodology: chargebacks_filed / customer_wins; monthly target >= 36.5%
dictionary.plain_english: Chargebacks filed per customer win. Higher is better. Target: at least 36.5%.

dictionary.methodology: chargebacks_won / chargebacks_decided; monthly target >= 60.0%
dictionary.plain_english: Share of decided chargebacks the bank won. Higher is better. Target: at least 60.0%.

dictionary.methodology: claims_withdrawn / claims; monthly target <= 7.0%
dictionary.plain_english: Share of claims the customer withdrew. Lower is better. Target: at most 7.0%.

dictionary.methodology: recovered_amount / credited_amount; monthly target >= 22.0%
dictionary.plain_english: Share of money credited to customers that came back through chargebacks. Higher is better. Target: at least 22.0%.

dictionary.methodology: written_off_claims / customer_wins; monthly target <= 78.0%
dictionary.plain_english: Share of customer wins where the bank absorbed at least part of the credit. Lower is better. Target: at most 78.0%.

dictionary.methodology: written_off_amount / claimed_amount; monthly target <= 53.0%
dictionary.plain_english: Share of disputed dollars the bank absorbed as a loss. Lower is better. Target: at most 53.0%.
